title: A train cannot recheck a queue item its branch closed
what: When a queue item closed on a task branch needs a fresh check on the train that carries that branch, a checker on the train can record a check of that item, so the merge hook accepts the train without going back to the task branch.
why: 26 Oct evening, measured on wt/train-19: the item a-test-leaves-a-real-gate-running-that-holds-a-s was closed on wt/leaked-gate, then commit 87eddeb moved one test class in tests/test_gate.py. The merge hook refused the train ("the check of 6ab988296859 is of no queue item, not of 'a-test-leaves-a-real-gate-running-that-holds-a-s'"); a checker on wt/train-19 got "Item: none" from relay check findings because taken_by is wt/leaked-gate, and the input file has no field to name the item. The workaround is a recheck on the task branch and a fresh merge into the train. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: A temporary repo: item closed on wt/a, a non-inert commit on wt/a after the check, wt/train-1 merges wt/a; a checker on wt/train-1 cannot record a check of the item, and the merge of wt/train-1 is refused.
pass_cases: The checker on the train records a check of the item and the merge passes; a train whose item has no check after its last change is still refused; a check on the task branch still counts.
where: plugins/core/hooks/merge.py (closed item needs a check after its last non-inert change)
relay check findings (Item: none on a train)
